properties.displayName: [WEEKLY] Developer/Data-tooling Daemon Spawns Shell Child Seconds After POST to Runner/Exec Endpoint
properties.description:
Detects the joint pattern across this fortnight's GHSA critical-severity disclosures where a long-running developer or data-tooling daemon (Node.js, Python, Jupyter kernel/Enterprise Gateway, Stata) receives an inbound HTTP POST to a code-execution-adjacent endpoint (`/runners/start`, `/runners/load-reader`, `/api/kernels`, `/start`, `/stata_do`, `/workspaces/*/members`, etc.) and within seconds spawns an OS shell, LOLBin, or alternate interpreter as a child — the universal post-condition of code injection (DbGate CVE-2026-47668/47670), arbitrary-file-write turned RCE (DbGate Zip Slip CVE-2026-47669), command injection (MCP-for-Stata CVE-2026-47708), SSTI (Jupyter EG CVE-2026-44181), YAML manifest injection (Jupyter EG CVE-2026-44182), and path-traversal-to-exec (NASA AMMOS CVE-2026-47731). It spans the exploit -> install kill-chain boundary by correlating the network ingress (vulnerable endpoint hit) with the host-side proof of code execution (parent-child anomaly) inside a 2-minute window on the same host. Fires when a vulnerable runner endpoint is POSTed AND the same daemon process spawns sh/bash/cmd/powershell/curl/wget/python/perl within 120s; does NOT fire on the routine background tasks these daemons spawn (helper Node workers, child Python kernels of the same family, scheduled cron-jobs) nor on POSTs to read-only endpoints, keeping FP rate low even in noisy CI/MLOps environments.

Rationale: The 12 articles share one observable joint pattern: a long-lived developer/data-tooling daemon accepts an HTTP POST to an execution-adjacent endpoint and then immediately spawns a shell, LOLBin, or alternate interpreter — the universal payoff of code injection, SSTI, manifest injection, command injection, and path-traversal-to-RCE. Correlating the inbound POST with the parent-child anomaly within a 2-minute window on the same host catches every variant in the fortnight (DbGate Node, Jupyter EG Python, Stata, AMMOS Python) while suppressing routine helper-process spawns that don't follow a vulnerable-endpoint POST.
properties.query:
let Window = 2m;
let RunnerPaths = dynamic(["/runners/start","/runners/load-reader","/api/kernels","/stata_do","/workspaces/","/auth/login"]);
let RunnerHits =
    union isfuzzy=true
        (W3CIISLog
            | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
            | where csMethod == "POST"
            | where csUriStem has_any (RunnerPaths)
            | project NetTime=TimeGenerated, Host=Computer, SrcIP=cIP, ReqUri=csUriStem, UA=csUserAgent),
        (AzureDiagnostics
            | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
            | where Category in ("ApplicationGatewayAccessLog","FrontDoorAccessLog","AppServiceHTTPLogs")
            | where httpMethod_s == "POST" or CsMethod_s == "POST"
            | extend Uri = coalesce(requestUri_s, csUriStem, originalRequestUriWithArgs_s, "")
            | where Uri has_any (RunnerPaths)
            | project NetTime=TimeGenerated, Host=coalesce(hostname_s, host_s, Resource), SrcIP=coalesce(clientIp_s, ClientIp_s, CIp_s), ReqUri=Uri, UA=coalesce(userAgent_s, csUserAgent,""))
    | where isnotempty(Host);
let Children =
    union isfuzzy=true
        (SecurityEvent
            | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
            | where EventID == 4688
            | where ParentProcessName has_any ("node.exe","python.exe","php.exe","php-fpm.exe","w3wp.exe","stata.exe","xstata.exe")
            | where NewProcessName has_any ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","bash.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","python.exe","perl.exe")
            | project ProcTime=TimeGenerated, Host=Computer, ParentBinary=tostring(split(ParentProcessName,"\\")[-1]), ChildBinary=tostring(split(NewProcessName,"\\")[-1]), ChildCmd=CommandLine, Account=SubjectUserName),
        (Syslog
            | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
            | where Facility == "authpriv" or ProcessName in ("audispd","auditd","sshd")
            | where SyslogMessage has_any ("comm=\"sh\"","comm=\"bash\"","comm=\"curl\"","comm=\"wget\"","comm=\"python\"")
            | where SyslogMessage has_any ("node","python","stata","php-fpm","uvicorn","gunicorn")
            | extend ParentBinary=extract(@"pcomm=\"([^\"]+)\"",1,SyslogMessage), ChildBinary=extract(@"comm=\"([^\"]+)\"",1,SyslogMessage), ChildCmd=SyslogMessage, Account=extract(@"uid=(\d+)",1,SyslogMessage)
            | project ProcTime=TimeGenerated, Host=HostName, ParentBinary, ChildBinary, ChildCmd, Account);
Children
| join kind=inner RunnerHits on Host
| where ProcTime between (NetTime .. NetTime + Window)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ProcTime, NetTime)
| project ProcTime, NetTime, DelaySec, Host, SrcIP, ReqUri, UA, ParentBinary, ChildBinary, ChildCmd, Account
| order by ProcTime desc
